The case of the prosecution is that, CW.1 was doing money lending business by obtaining money from Sindhi Bankers Association on one percent interest by verifying the customer's documents regarding bank statement, I.T returns and other relevant documents.

Likewise, people of his community were also doing same business since 2012 under the name of R. M.
Traders and one Raghavendra getting money from said traders.

Thereafter, due to suspicion,
CW.1 enquired about Manjanath Trader by verifying relevant documents and then confirmed that it was locked.

Further CW.1 came to know that the accused have created R.M. 4. In order to prove the case of the prosecution,
the prosecution has examined PW.1 and not got marked any document.
On closure of the evidence on the side of the prosecution, the statement of the accused u/sec. 313 Cr.PC was dispensed as there is no incriminating evidence against the accused.
5. Heard the arguments.
Perused the documents placed on record.

6. The points that arise for consideration are :
 1. Whether the prosecution has proved  beyond all reasonable doubt that  accused have committed the offences  U/s 419, 420, 465, 468, 471, 473 r/w  34 of I.P.C.?
 2. What order ?

7. The above points are answered as under :
 Point No.1: In the Negative.

Point No.2: As per final order for the following :
 REASONS  8. Point No.1 : The accused in furtherance of common intention to cheat CW.1 as well as public have created R.M. 4 Enterprises and getting loan of Rs.80,00,000/- and cheated public as well as CW.1 and thereby the accused have committed the aforesaid offences.
9. In order to prove the guilt of the accused prosecution has examined CW.1 as PW.1.
PW.1 is the complainant, in the chief has not deposed in support of the prosecution case and turned hostile.
Even in the cross examination nothing is elicited.

10. Further, despite issued NBW and proclamation to other witnesses of the prosecution on several occasion, the prosecution has not secured the presence of said witnesses and thereby they did not turn up to adduce evidence.
Upon careful perusal of the material placed by the prosecution, there is no iota of evidence on record to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
It is, therefore, the prosecution has miserably failed to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
The accused are entitled to benefit of doubt.
Hence, answered the point No.1 in the Negative.
